% Macro-heavy source. Edge cases showcased:
%   - zero-arg \newcommand, multi-arg \newcommand, and \def
%   - a macro defined in terms of another macro (nested expansion)
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, amsthm, amssymb}

\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}

\newcommand{\field}{\mathbb{F}}
\newcommand{\poly}[1]{\field[#1]}
\def\deg{\operatorname{deg}}
\newcommand{\degpoly}[1]{\deg \poly{#1}}

\begin{document}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:macros}
For a nonconstant $f \in \poly{x}$ we have $\degpoly{x} \geq 1$ over the field $\field$.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
